Kenya Grants Amnesty Amidst Foreign Trader Crackdown

Kenya has initiated a crackdown on foreign traders, leading to fear among migrant communities. In response to the growing apprehension, which has reportedly driven hundreds to seek refuge at Kenya's embassy, the government has announced a temporary amnesty program. This amnesty is intended for undocumented individuals residing in the country. The crackdown has raised concerns about the impact on migrant populations within Kenya.
